name: Kyoto

flag.description: A white six-leafed flower on a violet field, holding a yellow 京 (kyō) drawn as a human figure.
flag.symbolism: The six leaves stand for the dignity of the old capital, and the 京 in their heart for the people of Kyoto joining their strength.

hook: Kyoto's white flower on violet has a yellow 京 (kyō), for Kyoto, at its heart.
trivia: Kyoto was Japan's imperial capital for more than a thousand years, from 794 to 1869.
The prefecture also reaches north to the Sea of Japan at Amanohashidate.
